name: domain.context_compiler
description: AST-based 3-tier token-efficient context compilation, skeletonization, and reachability resolver for agent workflows

entrypoints.name: compile_context
entrypoints.description: Compile a 3-tier token-efficient context window (Full source, Skeletonized dependencies, Excluded files) with prompt string and diagnostics

parameters.name: target_file
parameters.description: Path to the file actively being targeted or edited

parameters.name: max_hops
parameters.description: Maximum call and import hops outward to include in Tier 2 (default: 2)

entrypoints.name: skeletonize_code
entrypoints.description: Strip function and method bodies from Python source, preserving signatures and docstrings

parameters.name: source_code
parameters.description: Raw Python code string to skeletonize

entrypoints.name: resolve_reachability
entrypoints.description: Perform multi-hop AST symbol and import reachability analysis from a target file

parameters.name: target_file
parameters.description: Target file to begin reachability traversal from

parameters.name: max_hops
parameters.description: Maximum call and import distance hops outward (default: 2)

entrypoints.name: estimate_token_reduction
entrypoints.description: Calculate potential token savings of compiled 3-tier context versus a naive repository dump
